{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p = 'specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md'
s = open(p).read()

# Update counts and traceability in the checklist to reflect milestone 2 additions
s = s.replace(
    '- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous (FR-001..FR-013 each state a
  concrete observable behavior)',
    '- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous (FR-001..FR-021 each state a
  concrete observable behavior; FR-014..FR-021 added for milestone 2 R04-R06 and
  the round-2 R05 expiry clarification)')
s = s.replace(
    '- [x] Success criteria are measurable (SC-001..SC-005)',
    '- [x] Success criteria are measurable (SC-001..SC-008; SC-006..SC-008 added
  for invalidate_many, resize, generator-tag and repeated-detachment criteria)')
s = s.replace(
    '- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined (14 Given/When/Then scenarios)',
    '- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined (23 Given/When/Then scenarios
  across User Stories 1-4; User Story 4 added for R04-R06)')
s = s.replace(
    '- [x] Edge cases are identified (8 edge cases)',
    '- [x] Edge cases are identified (15 edge cases; 7 added for R04-R06 and the
  R05 expiry clarification)')
s = s.replace(
    '- [x] Dependencies and assumptions identified (A1-A8; existing LRUCache)',
    '- [x] Dependencies and assumptions identified (A1-A11; existing LRUCache;
  A9 records the superseded conflicting design note; A10 scopes the R05
  expiry clarification; A11 defines invalidate_many count semantics)')
s = s.replace(
    '- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows (P1 store/retrieve, P2 invalidate/LRU,
  P3 config/replacement safety)',
    '- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows (P1 store/retrieve, P2 invalidate/LRU,
  P2 multi-tag/resize/lazy-tags, P3 config/replacement safety)')
s = s.replace(
    '- Traceability: FR-001..FR-013 map to milestone requirements R01 (FR-002..004),
  R02 (FR-005..FR-009), R02 extension/Claim-A (FR-010), R03 (FR-001, FR-011,
  FR-012), and API preservation (FR-013).',
    '- Traceability: FR-001..FR-021 map to milestone requirements R01 (FR-002..004),
  R02 (FR-005..FR-009), R02 extension/Claim-A (FR-010), R03 (FR-001, FR-011,
  FR-012), API preservation (FR-013), R04 (FR-014..FR-016), R05 (FR-017,
  FR-018), R05 round-2 clarification (FR-019), and R06 (FR-020, FR-021). See the
  Requirement Traceability table in spec.md. The conflicting old design note
  (empty all-tags matches every key; resizing may flush) is superseded by
  R04/R05 and recorded as assumption A9.')
s = s.replace(
    '**Created**: 2026-10-17',
    '**Created**: 2026-10-17\n**Updated**: 2026-10-17 (milestone 2 + round-2 clarification)')
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print('checklist updated')
PYEOF
grep -n "FR-021\|SC-008\|A11\|User Story 4\|A9" specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md"}
